findings.title: Inverted lightness percentages in `.embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a`
findings.body: The original rule `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` was replaced with `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`, swapping the `30%` and `70%` lightness values. This changes the light-theme color from 30% to 70% lightness and leaves embedded post author links low-contrast against the background in both light and dark themes. It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))` (matching `.names span a` in `common/base/topic-post.scss`).

findings.title: Inverted lightness percentages in `.custom-message-length`
findings.body: The original rule `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)` was replaced with `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`, swapping the `70%` and `30%` lightness values. This makes `.custom-message-length` much darker in light themes and much brighter in dark themes than intended, and is inconsistent with the same selector in `app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/modal.scss` (line 94), which uses `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`.

findings.title: `.topic-map h3` lightness changed from 20%/80% to 50%/50%
findings.body: In `.topic-map h3`, `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)` was changed to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))` instead of `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%))` (compare with `.topic-map h3` in `desktop/topic-post.scss` line 321). This alters the light-theme color and gives `h3` the same muted shade as `h4` in the mobile topic map.

findings.title: `.group-member-info .name` lightness changed from 30%/70% to 50%/50%
findings.body: In `.user-stream .group-member-info .name`, `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` was replaced with `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))` instead of `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))` (compare with `.user-detail .name` in `common/base/user.scss` line 124). This changes the light-theme color and removes the contrast distinction between `.name` and `.title`.

findings.title: `.group-member-info .name` lightness changed from 30%/70% to 50%/50%
findings.body: In `.user-stream .group-member-info .name`, `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` was replaced with `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))` instead of `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`, altering the light-theme color and removing the visual distinction between `.name` and `.title`.

findings.title: Missed `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)` in `.topic-list.categories .category .badge-notification`
findings.body: `.topic-list.categories .category .badge-notification` still uses `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)` without `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`, unlike the matching `.category .badge-notification` rule in `app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/header.scss` (line 301).
